page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, running head at top, page number at top left; a printed catchword "PO-" at the lower right; a fleuron ornament below the text. Show-through from the other side of the leaf at right is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Verùm perpetua si Sapientiæ Facundo reserat iura recondita Ore, & si placidis cœtibus indicat Qua cœlum petitur via:
Illi mella, fluunt æmula nectari, Sacro digna sonat ritè silentio, Et quæ vulgus amat, turbáq; doctior Intentis bibit auribus.
Sic mirata suum Græcia Nestorem Olim densa humeris dulciloquum audiit: Quum verba eximiis picta leporibus Cano pectore promeret.
Sic mirata frequens audiit Herculem Prisci's temporibus Gallia Celticum, Aures quum domitas duceret aureis Victrix lingua catenulis.
Sic Musis niteas Bezafauentibus Semper conspicuo vertice clarior, Et nomen meritis laudibus inclitum Cunctis Gentibus inferas.
Maiorem invidia te petat Invidus, Ceu Cygnum obstreperis vocibus anseres, Et ceu quum rabidis Lunam vlulatibus Nocturnus canis impetit.

page.notes: Long s is rendered as plain s; "Prisci's" is printed "Priscis" with a long-s/ligature form and should be checked. Lines with the ligature "si" and the "&" are as printed. The fleuron below the text is an ornament, not transcribed.
